content.heading: Locus standi
content.text: Where a legal wrong or legal injury is caused to a person or class of persons by reason of violation of constitutional or legal rights, and such person or class by reason of poverty, disability, or socially or economically disadvantaged position cannot approach the court, any member of the public acting bona fide may move the court for judicial redress. Liberalised standing is a rule of procedure and access; it does not create a new writ or enlarge the underlying rights. A private dispute, personal rivalry, or motivated petition dressed as public interest does not satisfy locus for PIL.
